decisionsTitle: «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» for every desk role: the desk's volunteers read who takes part and sign a runner up there, the files and the organizers' presses staying theirs (amending §984, §983 and §949)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, from a phone:** «vreau sa bagi voluntarii pe lista de tombola by default» and «voluntarii locati [logați] nu vad tabul de Tomboloa, doar adminii si organizatorii vad acest tab» — the volunteers who sign in do not see the raffle's tab, only the administrators and the organizers do.

**What was there.** «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» (§984) was drawn and served for `canTakeRaffleList` alone — the Organizer and the Administrators, the gate §949 had set for the raffle's tick («doar adminul și organizatorul pot bifa și vedea asta»). A «Voluntar» at the desk read «Tombolă: participă / nu participă» under each runner a search found and signed one up there (the DESK door, §984), but had no list of who takes part: the tab was not drawn for them, and its address answered the 404 an unknown page gets.

**Decision.**

- **The tab is every desk role's.** A predicate of its own, `canReadRaffle` (`staff-identity/domain/roles.ts`), written as `canWorkTheDesk` so the two lines move together: the Voluntar, the Redactor, the Organizer, Tehnic and the Administrators — never a member, who is no staff (§524). Drawn among «Ziua cursei»'s tabs for an event that holds a raffle, asserted by the page (a 404 to anybody else), by the roster's read (`raffle-list.ts#readRaffleRoster`) and by the desk's press and its service. A desk role's row is then four entries — «Prezența», «Sosiri», «Tombolă», «Lucruri» —, which still fit a 320-pixel phone whole.
- **What a desk role that is not an organizer reads there:** the same table — number, name, group, «Participă» with the reason, «Prezent» —, the settings line, the counts and the four filters «Toți», «Participă», «Nu participă», «Doar prezenții», under an intro of its own (`Admin.raffle.introDesk`, both languages: who takes part and who is present, and that with a separate sign-up they sign a runner up there once the person has accepted the rules). Never an address, an email or a telephone: the roster carries none — a name, a number, a group, a state and whether the person was there.
- **What it does there:** the desk's «Înscrie la tombolă» — the same `raffleDeskSignUpAction`, its gate now `canReadRaffle`, the DESK door with the desk member as the recorder — on the row of a registration that may still sign up: the sign-up mode with its gate open, confirmed with a number, not in yet, and not taken out by the organizers, as the desk asks (`raffle-roster.ts`'s `deskMaySignUp`, beside `raffleLineOf`). The tick «A acceptat regulamentul» is the person's acceptance on paper or aloud, required by the browser and again by the service. The press comes back to the tab with its event and filter: at the row with the toast, or at the alert with the refusal. A volunteer's row and a line of the elite list have no press for them: their one staff door is the organizers' (STAFF).
- **What stays the organizers'** (`canTakeRaffleList`): «Lista pentru tombolă (CSV)» and «— doar prezenții», names that leave the site — the buttons are not drawn and the route still answers 403 —; «Scoate» / «Pune înapoi»; «Șterge înscrierea»; an elite line's «Prezent» tick (its value is said in words); «Înscrie» of anybody (STAFF); the way to the editor (`canEditEventFields`); the column «Înscris» — how and when each person signed up, the sign-up's own details, which the privacy notice says the organizers and the administrators see —; and the reason «scos de organizatori», which every other desk role reads as a plain «Nu», as at the desk (§984). «Tipărește» stays everybody's: the browser prints whatever page it shows.
- **The words:** the guide's race-day section gains «La tombolă: cine participă, și înscrie pe cineva» / “At the raffle: who takes part, and signing somebody up” — who opens the tab, what the table says, the sign-up and its tick, what stays the organizers' —, and «Ce poate fiecare rol» names the tab for the Voluntar. `AGENTS.md` §10.2 and §15.11, `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-060, `SETUP.md` § 34 and § 47 and `docs/WHERE-THINGS-LIVE.md` say the same.

**What this amends.** §984's gate for the tab, and with it §949's «doar adminul și organizatorul pot … vedea asta» for the answer, which the desk already said to every desk role since §984; and §983's «never the desk» for a volunteer's «Prezent», which the tab now says in words beside whether the person takes part — the tick and its press stay on the «Voluntari» list, which only the organizers open (`tests/unit/volunteers/presence-never-leaves.test.ts` says why the tab may read it).

**Refused.**

- *The organizers' presses for every desk role.* Taking a person out, putting them back and deleting a sign-up are the organizers' decisions (§949, §984); a volunteer at the desk who meets one calls an organizer, as the guide says.
- *The two files for every desk role.* They are names that leave the site, recorded as an export (§322); the volunteer at the raffle reads the list on the screen.
- *How and when for every desk role.* The answer is what the desk needs; the door and the moment are the sign-up's own record.

**Not done.** The message's first line — the event's volunteers on the raffle's list by default — is not this decision's: it only opens the tab. The text file for random.org that numbers the raffle without names is meant for whoever reads the tab: its gate becomes `canReadRaffle` when it lands beside this one.
changelogLine: - **«Tombolă» for the desk's volunteers** — every desk role, the «Voluntar» included, now opens «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» on an event that holds a raffle: everybody by number with whether they take part and were there, the counts and the four filters, and «Înscrie» on a runner's row once the person accepted the rules; the two files, «Scoate» / «Pune înapoi», «Șterge înscrierea», how and when each signed up and «scos de organizatori» stay the Organizer's and the Administrators'. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 214. Given «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» (`/admin/checkin/tombola`), then it is drawn among the race day's tabs for an event that holds a raffle and is a page for every role that works the desk — the Voluntar, the Redactor, the Organizer, the Tehnic, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canReadRaffle`) —, a 404 to a member, the roster's read refusing a member too (`FORBIDDEN`); to a role that does not take the raffle's files (`canTakeRaffleList`: the Organizer and the Administrators) it shows the same table — number, name, group, «Participă» with the reason, «Prezent» —, the settings line, the counts and the four filters, under words of its own in both languages, and never «Lista pentru tombolă (CSV)», «— doar prezenții», «Scoate» / «Pune înapoi», «Șterge înscrierea», an elite line's «Prezent» tick, the organizers' «Înscrie», the way to the editor, the column «Înscris» (how and when) or the reason «scos de organizatori», which it reads as «Nu»; the page carries nobody's address, email or telephone, and the file's route still answers 403 to such a role (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» opened by a desk role that does not take the raffle's files, at an event whose raffle asks a sign-up with its gate open, then the row of a registration that may still sign up — confirmed with a number, not in, not taken out by the organizers — carries the desk's «Înscrie la tombolă» with the required tick «A acceptat regulamentul», which records a DESK sign-up with the desk member as its recorder and no trace and comes back to the tab with its event and filter, at the row with its toast; without the tick, or for a member, nothing is written and the refusal comes back to the tab's alert; a volunteer's row, a line of the elite list, a person waiting and a person taken out carry no press; and the desk role's row of «Ziua cursei» holds four entries that fit a 320-pixel phone whole (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Tombolă» for every desk role, the volunteers included
